lines.game.karaoke.pushed: You've stopped singing. You're standing there reading the screen and reviewing it. 'Oh, THIS part.' You point at a guy. 'This guy knows.' He doesn't.
lines.game.karaoke.held: You stand there and call the words as they light up, one at a time, like a man announcing a very slow horse race.
lines.inspiration.struck: Oh, dude. DUDE. You punch yourself in the thigh about it. It's that good an idea.
lines.inspiration.expired: The idea's gone. You were going to get to it right after you saw whether you could jump that. You could not jump that.
lines.scavenge.found: You find {item}, and you find it with your shin.
lines.scavenge.nothing: Nothing. You kick something anyway, to have done something. It was heavier than it looked.
lines.item.used: You finish the {item} and crush it against your head, or try. It was a bottle. Everyone saw.
lines.making.started: You crack your knuckles, roll your neck, and knock over the thing you were about to work on. You pick it back up. You start.
lines.piece.artist.solid: Done: {work}. Nailed it. You go for a high five and there's nobody there, so you get the wall.
lines.piece.artist.rough: Done: {work}. You did it the way you do everything, which is hard and slightly to the left.
lines.location.return: Back at {place}, bud. Hit the door frame on the way in, same as last time. The door frame remembers.
